observations: SelectPlacePathV2 keeps the surface map_revision and geometry_hash and compares them with the request before selection.
stale revision returns MAP_REVISION_MISMATCH. A wrong surface hash returns GEOMETRY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.
valid=false with non-canonical z returns INVALID_GRID. valid=false with canonical z and state=free returns UNKNOWN_SURFACE_HAS_VALUE.
grasp contract_version 1 returns CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH. stamp_valid=false returns INVALID_STAMP.
An empty state array and a flagged empty height_above_floor array return INVALID_GRID. select_place_v2 is not called.
A legal unknown cell (valid=false, z=0, state=unknown) decodes to None and is not measured floor support.
A wrong container source frame returns FRAME_CONTRACT_MISMATCH and a NaN translation returns INVALID_NUMERIC_PAYLOAD before select_place_v2.
